immersiveenchanting.configuration.title: %s Settings
immersiveenchanting.config.disable_ancie: Allow enchanting without Ancient Books in the library. Materials and experience are still required.
immersiveenchanting.config.bookshelf_sea: How far in blocks to search for nearby chiseled bookshelves on the X axis.
How high in blocks above the table to search for chiseled bookshelves on the Y axis.
How far in blocks to search for nearby chiseled bookshelves on the Z axis.
immersiveenchanting.config.show_added_by: Show the name of the mod that added the enchantment in the Ancient Book tooltip.
immersiveenchanting.config.allow_enchant: Allow enchantments to be removed at the enchanting table.
immersiveenchanting.config.item_carousel: Time in milliseconds between material options in an enchanting table tooltip.
immersiveenchanting.config.play_node_hov: Play a sound when the pointer moves over a node in the enchanting table.
immersiveenchanting.config.enchanted_boo: Controls replacement or removal of enchanted books in native Immersive Enchanting loot. This pack supplies its own loot rules.
immersiveenchanting.config.obfuscate_loc: Hide details of enchantments the player has yet to unlock in the enchanting table.
immersiveenchanting.config.disable_encha: Removes the ordinary enchanted book offers. This pack restricts their enchantment types and levels.
